6. Automated Decision-Making
6.1 The University may use automated systems or tools to assist in decision
making processes. These may include analysing personal information to
support administrative, educational, research, or service-related functions.
6.2 Where an automated decision-making process is used, the University will:
6.2.1 ensure the use of personal information complies with the PRIS Act,
including the IPPs;

accurate, and based on reliable and up to date information;
6.2.3 provide individuals with information about the use of automated

affects them;

where an automated process has materially influenced an
outcome; and

prevent unlawful discrimination, bias, or adverse impacts arising
from automated processes.

assessment requirements

case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Purpose-bounded authorisation for combined standing powers, with security, intervention and contestability of consequential actions.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Although general protections in N179 (4.1), N077 (1.6), and N084 (6.4) restrict unapproved access and sole automated consequential decisions, no relevant provision was identified in the documents and searches checked establishing purpose-bounded authorisation, real-time intervention, or coordinated oversight for an AI agent exercising standing powers across LMS, enrolment, advising, support, and assessment systems.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's ICT Security Policy (N179, 4.1) enforces least-privilege authorised access, IT Conditions of Use (N077, 1.6) restrict account sharing, and Privacy Procedure (N084, 6.4) bars sole automated decisions affecting rights or services without human involvement. However, no relevant provision was identified in the documents and searches checked establishing purpose-bounded authorisation, real-time intervention, or unified cross-system oversight for an AI agent exercising standing powers across LMS, enrolment, advising, support, and assessment systems, leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
